author: pgaudet
body:
See https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31140

- [x] GO:0043760 acetyldiaminopimelate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity - No xref, no annotations
- [x] GO:0070529 L-tryptophan transaminase activity - no xref, previous (unnecessary) grouping term. 1 direct EXP annotation to Aspergillus tdiD (A7XRY8) from PMID:17704773 by UniProt. But UniProt also annotates from the paper to EC:2.6.1.28/Rhea:13741 = GO:0047299 L-tryptophan:phenylpyruvate transaminase activity, so change to that.
- [x] GO:0070548 L-glutamine transaminase activity
title: Review annotations to some amino acid transaminase activity terms
